definition: Systematic testing designed to measure specific abilities of an AI model, such as reasoning, coding, or tool use, often as part of assessing frontier model risk.
details: Capability evaluations are increasingly used by AI labs and third parties to track how model abilities are progressing, informing both product decisions and safety-related deployment decisions.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Capability Evaluation.
